profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
I have been working as a programmer since 2002.  I enjoy problem solving and creating useful programs and/or reports to help colleagues complete their duties in a faster manner, or to help them analyze data.
I listen to their requirements whether it is for new programs, changes to existing programs or reports. I am patient, accommodating, pleasant to work with and personable.  I believe that a key point to a good work environment involves good rapport amongst its employees, and I try to achieve this in my interactions with people I meet and work with.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Create Business Intelligence solutions for various internal departments and external Plan Sponsors. These reports are used for data analysis, financial information, error checking, and improving daily work efficiency.
•	Build SAP Universes (in Universe Designer and Information Design Tool) to retrieve data from Oracle databases, Microsoft databases, Personal data files, stored procedures and free-hand SQL.
•	Develop complex reports using Web Intelligence reporting tools and PL/SQL.   These requests require a creative approach and an understanding of the business’ work flow
•	Analyze and resolve discrepancies in data.
•	Assist business users and other developers in advanced Web Intelligence reporting topics such as merging dimensions, creating Detail objects, and calculations with context.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop web and windows applications using .NET/ASP, C#, AJAX and a MS SQL database
•	Create web-based reports and report output to Excel
•	Design and maintain new and existing databases, tables, relations, and views
•	All software is developed in house.  Areas of business include inventory, picking, purchasing, receiving, shipping, yard management, label customization and printing, scheduling, and accounting
•	Write end user help documents for new software developed

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Analyze and develop new user interfaces and make changes to existing interfaces in Law Manager (litigation management software)
•	Create Oracle Tables and Views.  Program PL/SQL procedures to query an Oracle database used by the Legal Department.  These procedures are data and logic specific
•	Create Cognos Impromptu reports with the data obtained from procedures
•	Analyze existing report procedures and write documentation for end-users
•	Support day-to-day end-user issues on with array of different system, software and hardware issues.  Write up “Tip of the Week” articles for our staff
•	Member of the Legal Department’s Communications Team
